import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract feature columns and target
features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train_df[features].values
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].values
X_test = test_df[["Id"]].copy()
X_test.insert(1, "Id", range(len(X_test)))

# Split into train/validation sets - never refit model on validation
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Prepare labels for LightGBM
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_split, label=y_train_split, feature_name=features)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, feature_name=features, reference=train_data)

# Train LightGBM classifier
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(np.unique(y_train)),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "verbose": -1,
}
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate score on held-out set
pred_val = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
y_pred_val = np.array([f"{int(round(p))}" for p in pred_val])
score_val = ((y_pred_val == y_val).sum()) / len(y_val)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {score_val:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
X_test_clean = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])
X_test_values = X_test_clean[features].values
pred_test = model.predict(X_test_values, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file
submission = sample_submission.copy()
submission["Cover_Type"] = [f"{round(p)}" for p in pred_test]
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
